opening.argument: The video directs viewers to an external website presented as a generator for Lowe's promotional codes, with the title promising “FREE Lowe's PROMO Codes! (Generator).” The speaker says, “It'll generate a promo code for you,” then instructs viewers to select an item and copy the code from the website. He further links refreshing the page to “get 10% off your purchase” and describes an option for an order over $50. These specific savings claims and instructions promote obtaining and applying a low-barrier discount code. The uploader nevertheless disclaims responsibility for the linked site and says he does not own it. The records do not establish Lowe's authorization, code validity, successful redemption, or any resulting loss.
